<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1800027_leve_sys.LeaveManagementUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>LeaveManagementUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var LeaveManagementUtils = Class.create();
LeaveManagementUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },

    calculateDuration: function() {
        var startDate = g_form.getValue('start_date');
        var endDate = g_form.getValue('end_date');
        var isHalfDay = g_form.getValue('is_half_day') == 'true';
        
        if (startDate && endDate) {
            var start = new Date(startDate);
            var end = new Date(endDate);
            
            var timeDiff = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
            var dayDiff = Math.ceil(timeDiff / (1000 * 3600 * 24)) + 1;
            
            if (isHalfDay) {
                dayDiff = 0.5;
            }
            
            g_form.setValue('duration', dayDiff);
        }
    },

    type: 'LeaveManagementUtils'
};

// Global function to be called from client scripts
function calculateDuration() {
    var utils = new LeaveManagementUtils();
    utils.calculateDuration();
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-17 17:39:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>48e566e9c3f22210a7f1b813e40131d1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LeaveManagementUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Leave Management System" source="x_1800027_leve_sys">9b184465c3beaa10a7f1b813e4013155</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Leave Management System">9b184465c3beaa10a7f1b813e4013155</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_48e566e9c3f22210a7f1b813e40131d1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-17 17:39:55</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
